reviewFindings.finding: The v1 gap is closed. v3 validates every supplied source object as a strict JSON tree, binds currentWholeDataCanonicalHash, and binds complete canonical hashes for inventory, manual declarations, and mechanics input. This rejects post-load in-memory mutations even if the separately supplied raw input hash map is unchanged.
reviewFindings.support: The 36 mutation controls include changed source/release metadata, unknown data/input properties, hidden own properties, accessors, proxies, cycles, non-finite and negative-zero numbers, sparse arrays, symbols, review promotions, and prior-binding loss/reordering. All reject with the intended guard.

reviewFindings.finding: The three UA p.28 equipment fields are exact current strings parsed into 33 cells, while each corresponding formal mechanics record remains unchecked, uninspected, and without value checkers. The 120 DMG175 manual targets and their values/context remain pending or unassessed; UA target-location reviews do not imply numerical value or context review. The four region-verified records remain a separate reference-level status count.
reviewFindings.support: The focused positive case, exact whole-object pins, status assertions, and mutation controls agree. The source-cohort test is a structural preservation proof, not independent source-pixel or semantic verification.

reviewFindings.finding: The source commit/tree relationship was independently checked against Git, but the helper itself does not verify HEAD or ancestry. Its sourceCommit field is returned from the closed fixture. This is acceptable for content-bound replay against descendants with identical pinned inputs; describe it as input provenance rather than proof of the active checkout identity.
